trustBoundary: The ForSelf adapter row is a reference deployment only: the security model requires the integrator to audit, vet and deploy their own copy under their own name; the row exists so an integrator can diff their deployment against Cork's reference. The CorkMarketCreator row is a Cork-operated deployment.
notices: Review level is unreviewed and stage is partner-preview: no production support commitment attaches to this component version.
Deployed via CREATE2 through the deterministic deployment factory: addresses are a function of salt and init code, not of the chain.

CorkForSelfAdapter is unchanged from 0.1.1: same address, same runtime codehash (re-verified on-chain 2026-08-14), bound to the phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1 pool manager and whitelist manager and the 1inch Limit Order Protocol v4; it binds no market-registry address.

CorkMarketCreator pre-creates a Cork pool with the exact derivation and checks of the LOP adapter's JIT path, so a smart-account bundle can replace the ERC-2612 permit leg (createNewPool -> approve -> fillOrderArgs with empty permits); a second call on an existing pool is an idempotent lookup.

CorkMarketCreator wiring, read from the contract on both chains 2026-08-14: POOL_MANAGER 0x02803Bb52D2184f906F45B50C66AA969C2E37263, CONTROLLER 0x6b65D663e0B445BAf1870D5af806d57Ebb2C82A1, MARKET_REGISTRY 0xa78d8137B01058dD23e545b6557209eBBc9611F1 — identical to this Distribution's phoenix and market-registry pins.
CorkMarketCreator holds POOL_CREATOR_ROLE and FEE_MANAGER_ROLE on the controller — verified on-chain on both chains 2026-08-14 via hasRole; the creation path is live.
knownIssues: CorkMarketCreator's on-chain version() returns "0.1.0", not the repo version it was born in (0.1.3-rc.1) — an R2 deviation in the deployed artifact, recorded here rather than papered over. The codehash rows below, not the version string, identify the build.

CorkForSelfAdapter.description: Receiver-forcing adapter: pool actions plus fillOrderForSelf, no receiver parameter anywhere, approvals to the adapter only — proceeds can only land on the caller.

CorkMarketCreator.description: Pool pre-creation with the JIT path's exact derivation and checks (recipe membership -> oracle deploy -> constraint verify -> fee/expiry bounds); returns (poolId, cst, cpt); idempotent on an existing pool.
